claim: Patchline ships a mechanized rollback safety proof that every generated down-migration inverts its up-migration. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the rollback safety proof claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make mechanized-rollback-safety-gate`.
